annotations.title: Explain the UAE VAT return boxes

description: Use this when the user asks what goes in a box of the UAE VAT return (VAT 201), what box 1a, 3, 9 or 10 means, or how to report reverse charge, zero-rated or exempt sales. What goes in each box of the UAE VAT return (form VAT 201 in EmaraTax): the label as on the form, the columns, whether you fill it, it is pre-filled or calculated, and examples (marked as the FTA's own or an illustration), plus the rules people get wrong: which emirate in box 1, credit notes, the Adjustment column, reverse charge in boxes 3 and 10, zero-rated (box 4) versus exempt (box 5). Give box (for example 1a, 3 or 10) for one box, or leave it out for the whole form. With official sources and the date they were checked. Do not use it for a connected business's own figures by box (get_vat_return_boxes).

box.description: One box: 1 (all of 1a-1g), 1a…1g, or 2…14. Leave out for all boxes.
